_readme: Written by scripts/build-reagents.js: reagents of crafted gear (mats[item] = [[reagent, n]]), where each comes from, auction prices and quest gold per level.

favor._readme: Hand-kept. Merchant's Favor from Waylaid Crates of Textiles: a crate (world drop or Auction House) is filled with ONE bundle of its row and handed in for Favor. Ids: crates and fills from the client's item table; ranks, fills and Favor from the source. Used with Auctionator prices (data/prices.json) to say what a Favor recipe costs in gold.
